exercises.instructionUz: Kelajak nima keltiradi — O'qish, tinglash, gapirish va yozish mavzulari...
exercises.explanationUz:
4-MODULNING NOMI:
  'What the Future Holds'
  = Kelajak nima keltiradi / Kelajak nimani
    o'zida saqlaydi

  'to hold' bu yerda 'saqlamoq, o'zida tutmoq'
  ma'nosida.
  'What the future holds' — kelajakda nima
  bo'lishini bildiruvchi turg'un ibora.


MODULNING UMUMIY MAVZUSI:
  KELAJAK — rejalar, bashoratlar, qoidalar va
  ta'til.


BU MODULDA UCh UNIT BOR (13, 14, 15):

  UNIT 13 — 'Time Will Tell!'
     ('Vaqt ko'rsatadi!')
     Mavzular:
        • future plans / intentions / predictions
          (kelajak rejalari / niyatlar / bashoratlar)
        • horoscopes
          (munajjimlar bashorati)
     Rasmda: qiz o'ylanib turibdi, fikr pufagida
     'FOR SALE' yozuvli uy — kelajakdagi orzu.

  UNIT 14 — 'Dos and Don'ts'
     ('Qilinadigan va qilinmaydigan ishlar')
     Mavzular:
        • the environment  (atrof-muhit)
        • tips & rules     (maslahat va qoidalar)
     Rasmda: chiqindi qutisi va 'RECYCLE'
     (qayta ishlash) yozuvli konteyner.

  UNIT 15 — 'Take a Break!'
     ('Dam oling!')
     Mavzu:
        • holidays & sights
          (ta'til va diqqatga sazovor joylar)
     (O'ng betda)


UNIT NOMLARINING MA'NOSI:

  'TIME WILL TELL!'
     Turg'un ibora: 'Vaqt ko'rsatadi' —
     ya'ni kelajakda nima bo'lishini faqat vaqt
     aytadi.

  'DOS AND DON'TS'
     'do' va 'don't' fe'llaridan yasalgan OT
     birikmasi:
        DOS     = qilish kerak bo'lgan ishlar
        DON'TS  = qilmaslik kerak bo'lgan ishlar
     Qoidalar ro'yxati uchun ishlatiladi.

  'TAKE A BREAK!'
     'take a break' = tanaffus qilmoq, dam olmoq.
     Workbook 46-betdagi 13-mashqda ham bu ibora
     bor edi.


DIQQAT — MODUL TUZILIShI O'ZGARDI:
  1-3-modullarda HAR BIRIDA TO'RTTA unit bor edi
  (1-4, 5-8, 9-12).
  4-MODULDA esa faqat UChTA unit bor (13-15).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the future   = kelajak
  to hold      = saqlamoq, o'zida tutmoq
  an intention = niyat
  a prediction = bashorat
  a horoscope  = munajjimlar bashorati
  the environment = atrof-muhit
  a tip        = maslahat
  a rule       = qoida
  to recycle   = qayta ishlamoq
  a break      = tanaffus, dam
  a sight      = diqqatga sazovor joy

must, mustn't, can, can't.

exercises.explanationUz:
MODUL 4 — UNITS 13-15

KITOB VA'DA QILGAN YETTI KO'NIKMA:

  1) accept / refuse invitations
     (taklifni qabul qilish / rad etish)
     Masalan:
        'Would you like to come to my party?'
        'Yes, I'd love to!'          (qabul qilish)
        'I'm sorry, I can't.'        (rad etish)

  2) give advice
     (maslahat berish)
     Grammatikasi: SHOULD / SHOULDN'T
        'You should go to bed early.'
        'You shouldn't eat so much sugar.'

  3) give / refuse permission
     (ruxsat berish / rad etish)
     Grammatikasi: CAN / CAN'T
        'Can I use your phone?'
        'Yes, you can.' / 'No, you can't.'

  4) express obligation / prohibition
     (majburiyat / taqiqni ifodalash)
     Grammatikasi: MUST / MUSTN'T
        'You MUST wear a seatbelt.'   (majburiyat)
        'You MUSTN'T smoke here.'     (taqiq)

  5) make a reservation
     (joy band qilish)
     Masalan: mehmonxona yoki restoran uchun.

  6) invite someone out
     (kimnidir taklif qilmoq)
     Masalan: 'Would you like to go to the
     cinema?'

  7) buy souvenirs
     (esdalik sovg'a sotib olish)
     Unit 15 (ta'til) bilan bog'liq.


DIQQAT — 1, 3, 6-KO'NIKMALAR BOG'LIQ:
  Avval TAKLIF qilasiz (6),
  keyin taklif QABUL qilinadi yoki RAD etiladi (1),
  RUXSAT so'rash esa alohida ko'nikma (3).
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 4-modul muqovasi (o'ng bet), Learn how to

tasks.note:
'Yes, I'd love to!' (qabul)
'I'm sorry, I can't.' (rad)

SHOULD / SHOULDN'T bilan.
'You should ...' = ... qilishing kerak (maslahat).

CAN / CAN'T bilan.
'Can I ...?' — ruxsat so'rash.

MUST (majburiyat) / MUSTN'T (taqiq).
'You must ...' — shart.
'You mustn't ...' — taqiqlangan.

Mehmonxona yoki restoranda.
'a reservation' = bron, band qilish.

'invite sb OUT' = tashqariga (kinoga,
restoranga) taklif qilmoq.

Unit 15 (ta'til) bilan bog'liq.
Grammar 55-betdagi Edinburg xatida ham
'souvenir shops' bor edi.

exercises.explanationUz:
MODUL 4 DA MAShQ QILINADIGAN GRAMMATIKA:


1) BE GOING TO / WILL / PRESENT CONTINUOUS
   (kelajak ma'nosida)

   Uch xil KELAJAK shakli — har birining
   O'Z vazifasi bor:

     BE GOING TO  →  REJA va NIYAT
        'I'M GOING TO start a computer course.'
        (Kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.)
        Shuningdek: hozirgi DALILGA asoslangan
        bashorat:
        'There are dark clouds. It'S GOING TO
         rain.'

     WILL         →  TAXMIN, QAROR (shu payt)
        'I think it WILL rain.'
        (Menimcha yomg'ir yog'adi.)
        Grammar 54-betdagi 9-mashqda ham bor edi.

     PRESENT CONTINUOUS → REJALAShTIRILGAN
                          uchrashuv
        'I'M MEETING John at six.'
        (Soat oltida Jon bilan uchrashaman.)
        Workbook 50-betdagi 13-mashqda ham:
        'What are you doing this afternoon?'


2) THERE / IT WILL BE

     'THERE WILL BE a party tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga ziyofat bo'ladi.)

     'IT WILL BE cold tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga sovuq bo'ladi.)

   'there is/are' va 'it is' ning KELASI shakli.


3) MODAL FE'LLAR
   (should, shouldn't, must, mustn't, can, can't)

     SHOULD    →  maslahat
        'You should see a doctor.'
     SHOULDN'T →  salbiy maslahat
        'You shouldn't eat so much.'
     MUST      →  majburiyat, qat'iy shart
        'You must wear a uniform.'
     MUSTN'T   →  TAQIQ
        'You mustn't park here.'
     CAN       →  ruxsat / qobiliyat
        'You can go now.'
     CAN'T     →  ruxsat yo'q / qobiliyat yo'q
        'You can't come in.'

   HAMMASINING UMUMIY QOIDASI:
     • keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli keladi
       ('to' YO'Q, '-s' YO'Q, '-ing' YO'Q)
     • so'roqda modal fe'l oldinga chiqadi
       ('did/do' KERAK EMAS)


4) PRESENT PERFECT

     'I HAVE SEEN that film.'
     (Men u filmni ko'rganman.)

   Yasalishi: HAVE / HAS + fe'lning UChINChI
   shakli.
   Grammar Book 12-unitning nomida ham eslatilgan
   edi (Unit 12 sarlavhasi xato bosilgan
   betlarda).


DIQQAT — MODUL 4 NING TUZILIShI:
  Unit 13 → KELAJAK zamonlari
  Unit 14 → MODAL fe'llar (qoidalar, maslahat)
  Unit 15 → PRESENT PERFECT (ta'til tajribasi)


O'NG BETDAGI RASMLAR:
  • Yuqorida: Britaniya muzeyining Misr zali
    (haykallar va sarkofaglar) — Unit 15
    ('holidays & sights')
  • Pastda: Parijdagi Eyfel minorasi —
    Unit 15 ('sights')
  • Chapda pastda: 'Take a Break!' — Unit 15
    ('holidays & sights')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to accept    = qabul qilmoq
  to refuse    = rad etmoq
  an invitation = taklif
  advice       = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  permission   = ruxsat
  obligation   = majburiyat
  prohibition  = taqiq
  a reservation = bron, joy band qilish
  to invite    = taklif qilmoq
  a modal      = modal fe'l

('do/did' KERAK EMAS).

'You SHOULD see a doctor.' = ko'rinishing kerak.

kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + BE GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.   (REJA)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am going to start a computer course.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Oldindan o'ylangan REJA yoki NIYAT.
'be' fe'li ega bilan mos kelishi kerak
(am / is / are).

sentencePatterns.formula: I think + ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.   (TAXMIN)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think it will rain tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Dalilsiz TAXMIN.
'will' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: THERE WILL BE + ... .   /   IT WILL BE + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There will be a party tomorrow. It will be cold.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'there is/are' va 'it is' ning KELASI shakli.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should go to bed early. You shouldn't eat so much sugar.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Erta yotishing kerak. Bunchalik ko'p shakar yemasliging kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT berish qolipi.
'should' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: You MUST / MUSTN'T + ASOSIY fe'l.   (MAJBURIYAT / TAQIQ)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must wear a seatbelt. You mustn't smoke here.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xavfsizlik kamarini taqishing shart. Bu yerda chekish taqiqlangan.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + HAVE/HAS + fe'lning UChINChI shakli.   (PRESENT PERFECT)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have seen that film. She has been to Paris.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men u filmni ko'rganman. U Parijda bo'lgan.
